title: Haitian traditions of beings among us

tellings.quote: somebody just emailed me and told me about Traditions like that in Haiti you know and that you know he came to the United States and he could believe that we didn't have any belief in this at all when he would see things like that when he was there

plain: Diana Pasulka, a scholar who studies religion and UFO beliefs, says someone emailed her about traditions in Haiti of strange beings living among people. According to her, the man said that in Haiti he saw such things himself, and when he moved to the United States he could hardly believe that people there had no belief in them at all. If true, it would suggest these encounters are an everyday part of life in some cultures.
